summary: Frontend test of cart/checkout upsell-hint feature for product 8cd5b1c5. CRITICAL FAILURE: the hint logic does not honor the user's actual current per-unit price (individual_price + promo). It compares against the raw product.price (100₽) instead of the effective price (60₽), so it suggests tier@5 (−30% → 70₽) — which is WORSE per unit than what the user already pays. Per spec, that tier must be skipped and tier@10 (−50% → 50₽) must be shown with 'Добавьте ещё 8 шт.'. Apply-button also only steps to the next tier (qty 2→5), not directly to the genuinely better one (qty 10). No-tier product correctly shows no upsell hint.

ui_bugs.issue: Upsell hint suggests a tier that is more expensive per unit than the discount currently applied. Observed at qty=2 for product 8cd5b1c5: per-unit effective price is 60₽ (individual_price 75 − promo Распродажа 15), but hint shows '−30% / Добавить 3 шт.' which leads to tier@5 at 70₽/шт — a regression for the user. Per spec the hint must skip tier@5 and show tier@10 (−50%, 50₽/шт, +8 шт.).

After clicking 'Добавить N шт.' at qty=2, quantity becomes 5 (not the spec'd 10). The apply currently advances to the nearest tier the helper computed (tier@5), not to the genuinely best cheaper tier. Combined with bug #1, the user is pushed into a tier that is worse than the price they already had.

integration_issues.issue: CartPage.js and CheckoutPage.js call getNextBetterTier passing only { price: item.original_price, discount_active, discount_until, discount_tiers }. discount_type and discount_value are NOT passed, AND the user's individual_price + promo_amount are not factored in. As a result computeDiscount() inside getNextBetterTier returns null at qty<minTier and currentFinal falls back to product.price (=original_price=100₽), instead of the real 60₽ the user pays. Any tier cheaper than 100₽ (e.g. tier@5 → 70₽) is therefore wrongly classified as 'better'.

action_items: Fix the per-unit baseline used inside getNextBetterTier (or its callers) so it equals the user's actually paid per-unit price. Baseline should be: (individual_price ?? computeDiscount(product, qty).finalPrice ?? product.price) and then subtract any active promo amount (item.promo_active ? item.promo_amount : 0). Only tiers with finalPrice < baseline − 0.01 should be returned.

When the product has an individual_price, tier final prices typically should not apply on top of original price either — verify business rule with main agent. If tier discounts don't stack with individual_price, the upsell should likely be hidden entirely for products with individual_price.

Re-evaluate the 'apply' behavior: per spec, clicking apply at qty=2 must jump to the FINAL best-better tier (qty 10), not the immediate next tier (qty 5). Currently it jumps to nextTier.minQty=5 because getNextBetterTier returns tier@5 first. Once baseline is fixed (60₽), the function will naturally return tier@10 because tier@5 (70₽) is no longer cheaper than baseline.
Pass discount_type and discount_value from backend get_cart() (orders.py) into the cart item payload, so getNextBetterTier can reason about the base/tier discount correctly.

Fix React warning on /checkout: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (CheckoutPage)'. Line 201-202 calls navigate('/login'/'/cart') directly inside the render body. Move those into a useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: productHelpers.js getNextBetterTier() uses product.price as the fallback baseline. For cart items that have individual_price or active promos, this overstates the baseline. The function or its caller must accept an explicit currentPerUnitPrice argument and use it.
CartPage.js (line 250) and CheckoutPage.js (line 618) duplicate the exact same upsell calculation block — extract into a reusable hook/component to avoid divergence.
CheckoutPage.js performs navigate() during render (lines 201-202) which triggers a React warning. Wrap in useEffect.

success_rate.frontend: 25% (1/4 spec test cases pass: no-tier-product case; other 3 fail)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing product 8cd5b1c5-7980-4765-9db9-8e309614f8c5 (has individual_price + Распродажа promo + tiers) and aa56c8f3-b458-4b51-b192-5156e11f64fd (no tiers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro: login user@demo.com/demo123, set cart to product 8cd5b1c5 qty=2 via POST /api/cart/add then POST /api/cart/update. Visit /cart. Observed hint text: 'Добавьте ещё 3 шт. и получите скидку −30%' + apply button 'Добавить 3 шт.'. Expected: 'Добавьте ещё 8 шт. и получите скидку −50% (50 ₽/шт)' + 'Добавить 8 шт.'. The product shows per-unit 60₽ at qty=2 (line shows: 100 × 2 strikethrough, 75 × 2 individual, −15 ₽ Распродажа, 60 × 2). Cart endpoints are POST /api/cart/add, POST /api/cart/update, DELETE /api/cart/{pid}, DELETE /api/cart (not RESTful POST/PUT to /api/cart).
rca of the issue: In productHelpers.js getNextBetterTier(productLike, quantity), `currentFinal` is computed via computeDiscount(productLike, quantity). The caller passes only { price: item.original_price, discount_active, discount_until, discount_tiers } — discount_type/discount_value are missing AND the cart item's individual_price / promo are ignored. So at qty<min(tier), computeDiscount returns null (no tier match + no base discount supplied) → currentFinal = original_price = 100. Any tier whose finalPrice < 100 (e.g. tier@5 → 70) is then wrongly returned. The spec requires the baseline to be the user's actually paid per-unit (60₽ in this case), which would correctly skip tier@5 and surface tier@10.
